defuss-shadcn / Website / Resume & Portfolio / portfolio-zine

Zine Portfolio

A portfolio glued together by hand - grainy paper, a name in cut-out letters, a taped polaroid and a stamp, marker highlights and a handwritten note, zines scattered on the table, torn edges, fair tickets and a mailing list. One of the Resume & Portfolio styles.

Open full screen

Ama Owusu, collage artist

Paper, ink, a red and a marker yellow with Special Elite and Caveat on the page's root (brown paper in dark mode); pattern-grain over everything; a name of cut-out letters (each its own colour, face and tilt) that pop in one by one (data-df-stagger); frame-polaroid + frame-tape, a stamp and star stickers; Portfolio Grid (scatter); edge-torn-top on the dark band; ticket shapes for the fairs; Newsletter (card).

×%

Built from Portfolio Grid (scatter) and Newsletter (card). The paper palette and the three typefaces are set on the page's root; the cut-out letters, the tickets and the band are the page's own CSS. pattern-grain, frame-polaroid, frame-tape, stamp, shape-star, edge-torn-top and ticket are Shapes utilities, the pops Motion's.
